name: Generator and common bed assembly
function: Converts engine output into electrical power and supports the coupled engine-generator set.
location: Generator end and common base beneath the engine
maintenance: Inspect alignment, mounting bolts, vibration isolators and generator connections.

name: Jacket cooling water circulation system
function: Circulates cooling water through the engine jackets to control component temperatures.
location: Around the cylinder block and external cooling-water circuit
maintenance: Check coolant level and quality, leaks, pump condition, hoses and flow restrictions.

name: Lubricating oil supply, cooling and filtration system
function: Supplies clean, temperature-controlled lubricating oil to bearings and other moving components.
location: External oil circuit connected to the engine galleries and sump
maintenance: Monitor oil pressure and temperature; inspect filters, cooler, pumps and piping for contamination or leaks.

name: Dual-fuel gas injection system
function: Meters and delivers fuel gas to the cylinders during gas-mode operation.
location: Along the cylinder bank and gas supply manifold
maintenance: Inspect gas piping, valves, seals and connections; verify leak detection and isolation functions.

name: Fuel oil injection system
function: Pressurizes, meters and injects liquid fuel into each combustion chamber.
location: Along the cylinder bank between the fuel supply and cylinder heads
maintenance: Check injectors, high-pressure lines, pumps and connections for wear, leakage and correct calibration.

name: Starting air system
function: Supplies controlled compressed air to crank the engine during starting.
maintenance: Drain condensate and inspect valves, distributor, piping and safety devices for leaks or sticking.

name: Air intake system
function: Filters and directs combustion air into the engine cylinders.
location: Intake side of the engine and cylinder-head inlet passages
maintenance: Inspect filters, ducting, clamps and joints; remove restrictions and check for air leaks.

name: Cylinder head assembly
function: Seals the combustion chambers and supports the valves, injectors and associated passages.
maintenance: Inspect sealing faces, fasteners, valves, seats and fluid passages for wear, cracks or leakage.

name: Engine block
function: Forms the main engine structure and houses the cylinders, coolant passages and crankcase.
maintenance: Inspect for cracks, corrosion, leakage, damaged mounting surfaces and loose fasteners.

name: Engine rotating assembly
function: Converts reciprocating piston motion into rotary output at the crankshaft.
location: Inside the cylinders and lower crankcase
maintenance: Check bearings, journals, connecting rods, pistons, balance condition and lubrication clearances.
